verdict.rationale: Poly stores journal notes as plain Markdown files synced into a Mind folder. Files appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer, can be pinned to stay downloaded locally, and can be copied to local disk with the CLI `cp` command, so the archive exists in open formats outside the service. Missing for 10: documented export of Poly Mind memories and tags/metadata in an open format such as JSON, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the archive is usable without Poly.

support.subject: As a researcher, my notes are stored or exportable in open, documented formats (Markdown, JSON) so my archive outlives the vendor

citations.quote: New journal entries are Markdown files synced to your **Mind** folder.
your Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, with files downloading on demand and syncing back automatically.
Keep Downloaded (pinned) — the content is downloaded eagerly and never evicted.
cp — Copy between local disk and Poly, or within Poly
